verdict.rationale: TWC's own pages say employers can register for unemployment tax through UTR, its 'quick and free online service', and get a tax account number immediately. Wage reports and tax payments can then be filed and paid online via UTS. The robots probe failure concerns keyless agent access, not whether a founder can complete the transaction online, so it does not contradict the claim. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation of completing the online registration end to end.

support.subject: As a founder, the core transaction this service exists for (form, register, apply, file, or pay) can be completed online, per the service's own published pages

citations.quote: Registering is easy with Unemployment Tax Registration (UTR), TWC's quick and free online service.
If you are liable, you will immediately receive a TWC tax account number.
Learn about UTS to file wage reports, pay taxes, or manage an existing tax account online.
UTR will allow you to immediately file any reports or pay taxes that are due.
